name: google-cloud-solution-architecture
description: Interactively discovers requirements for a specific cloud workload and generates design recommendations and architectural guidance to build a multi-product solution in Google Cloud. Use this skill to generate holistic, end-to-end design recommendations and architectural guidance for complex, multi-product workloads on Google Cloud for specific use cases. Don't use this skill when other specialized skills (e.g., product-specific or google-cloud-recipe-*) directly address the user's workload or use case.
